title: Largest Odd Number in String
summary: Given a string representing a large integer, find and return the largest odd integer as a substring.
statement: Given a string representing a large integer, find and return the largest odd integer as a substring. If no odd integer exists, return an empty string.
constraints: num has 1 through 100000 digits and no leading zero.
Return the numerically largest odd-valued contiguous substring, or empty string when none exists.
The returned representation must preserve its characters from num.
hints: A decimal integer is odd exactly when its final digit is odd.
Scan from right to left for the last odd digit.
Return the entire prefix through that digit; if none exists, return empty string.
With no leading zero, every longer prefix is numerically larger, so the rightmost valid ending produces the largest possible odd substring.
editorial: With no leading zero, every longer prefix is numerically larger, so the rightmost valid ending produces the largest possible odd substring.

tests.explanation: The prefix 5 is the largest odd substring.
The entire number already ends in an odd digit and is therefore the largest candidate.
